purpose: Repeat the cached FLIP-particle axis diagnosis in fresh roots after correcting only attempt-33's false assumption that an initially disabled FLIP display implies an empty particle-system roster.

authority.scope: One fresh, local-only, zero-bake, zero-save, zero-render Blender diagnostic on a complete copied cache; ordinary research commit and non-force push are allowed.

priorAxisDiagnosis.surfaceDiagnosis: At peak frame 7, all 7,814 outside-union mesh vertices were below-floor; radial and above-rim counts were zero.

priorHarnessFailure.correction: Observe the initial use_flip_particles value and particle-system count independently. Accept only the three coherent initial rosters false/0, false/1 or true/1; expose or reuse exactly one system in memory, record the action, and continue without saving.

measurement.particleExposure: Observe the coherent initial roster; if disabled, set use_flip_particles=true only in process memory; require exactly one final evaluated particle system and display_percentage=100; do not save.
measurement.coordinateConvention: Blender Particle.location world-space converted by cup.matrix_world.inverted

classifications.aggregate: cup interior expanded by one base voxel on radial, floor and rim limits, matching the previous surface metric
classifications.strictInterior: raw measured cup interior with zero margin

interpretationRule.aggregateBelowFloorPositive: cached FLIP particles exceed the same one-voxel floor envelope; proceed to collision/effector diagnosis
interpretationRule.aggregateZeroStrictPositive: particles remain within one voxel of the physical interior while the reconstructed surface exceeds that envelope; treat the accepted-margin surface failure as reconstruction expansion and do not change collision physics
interpretationRule.aggregateAndStrictZero: particles are inside the raw cup interior; the measured surface failure is entirely reconstruction-side

stopRule: Stop on non-fresh roots, retained attempt-33 failure drift, source or copied-candidate manifest drift, symlink, cache-root or baked-flag mismatch, frozen setting mismatch, incoherent initial roster, absent or empty evaluated FLIP particles, process/log/result failure, any bake/save/render/network/remote-write count, banned media or resource failure. Never open either retained root directly and never save the in-memory particle exposure.
claimCeiling: One C1-corrected, zero-bake, zero-save, seven-frame cached-FLIP-particle per-axis diagnosis on a complete fresh copy of the failed resolution-192 static control. It distinguishes particle positions from reconstructed surface positions only; it does not prove a physical fix, slow tip, impact, render or finished-film quality.
